[[Shing Jea Monastery]] | pic1 = [[Image:Linnok Courtyard map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = Linnok Courtyard | pic2 = [[File:Monastery 2.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Panaramic screenshot | pic3 = [[Image:Linnok Courtyard temple guardian statue.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = A statue of a [[Temple Guardian]] | ingame name=Linnok Courtyard | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=252 }} [[Linnok Courtyard]] is a small plateau on the eastern side of [[Shing Jea Monastery]], atop a relatively long flight of stairs. This courtyard also connects to [[Saoshang Trail]], the only route from the western half of [[Shing Jea Island]] to [[Seitung Harbor]] and the eastern half. == Getting there == Head up the northeastern flight of stairs in [[Shing Jea Monastery]] past a [[Xunlai Agent]]. Many of the early [[profession]]-related quests will lead you here to meet with [[Master Togo]]. == Exits == * [[Saoshang Trail]] (East, it is locked for [[Factions]] characters until the quest [[the Road Less Traveled]], the actual gate is to the North) * [[Shing Jea Monastery]] (West) == Shrines == None. == Quests available == * [[Master Togo]] ** [[A Formal Introduction]] {{quest icon|primary}} ** [[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Factions quest)|Choose Your Secondary Profession]] {{quest icon|primary}} ** [[Speak with Headmaster Zhan (Warrior)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{w}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Greico (Ranger)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{r}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Amara (Monk)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{mo}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Kuju (Necromancer)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{n}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Kaa (Mesmer)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{me}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Vhang (Elementalist)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{e}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Lee (Assassin)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{a}}) ** [[Speak with Headmaster Quin (Ritualist)]] {{quest icon|primary}} ({{rt}}) ** [[The Road Less Traveled]] {{quest icon|primary}} == NPCs == === Allies === * {{rt}} 20 (20) [[Master Togo]] * {{rt}} 10 (20) [[Yijo Tahn]] (only for [[Factions]] characters that did not yet acquire [[Journey to the Master]]) * {{x}} 20 (20) [[Guard Tsukaro]] ([[gatekeeper]]) == Notes == * [[Interactive object]]s: **[[Tablet of Wisdom|Tablets of Wisdom]] (for Armor, Bows, Guilds, PvP, and Spirits) * Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.2% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title track. {{Anomaly|The secondary professions quests are offered in different order.}} {{anomaly|[[Master Togo]] is always seen in this area even after completion of the [[Factions]] campaign.}} {{Explorable areas in Shing Jea Island}} [[de:Linnok-Hof]]
